name: Feedback Tunnel
desc: An infinite video-feedback tunnel where a bold faceted ring and rotating spokes are copied back scaled-up and rotated every frame, spiralling endless echoes outward to the edges as a spectral vortex, neon kaleidoscope, thermal infrared, monochrome strobe, or iridescent oil-slick.

expand.doc: per-frame zoom of the feedback copy (>1 spirals echoes OUTWARD to fill the frame)

spin.doc: per-frame rotation of the feedback copy (swirl amount)

energy.doc: motif brightness + echo persistence (higher = brighter, longer trails)

density.doc: number of radial spokes + stroke weight

scale.doc: size of the injected ring motif
